descriptionChirho: A side or direction of a structure, territory, or boundary, used extensively in architectural and geographical descriptions (e.g., north side, south side of the tabernacle, temple, or promised land).
A corner or edge of a physical object or space, such as the corner of a field (Lev 19:9, 23:22), a bed (Amos 3:12), or an altar, distinct from the broader directional sense.

The temple or side-growth area of the head, referring to hair at the temples or sidelocks, as in the prohibition against rounding the corners of the head (Lev 19:27) and descriptions of peoples who clip the hair at the temples (Jer 9:25, 25:23, 49:32).
